_comment: Copy to tokens.json and fill in. NEVER commit the real file.
Each key is a bearer token; the value says who it belongs to and what it may do.
Two kinds of scope, checked differently:
MCP_REQUIRED_SCOPES is a floor. The SDK applies it to EVERY request with AND
semantics, so never put a write scope there or every read-only token needs it.
Per-tool scopes are declared with @needs_scope() in mcp_server.py and checked
against the token's own scopes. refresh_index needs docs:write.
A token that omits 'scopes' falls back to MCP_REQUIRED_SCOPES, so an entry written
before per-tool scopes existed is read-only rather than accidentally privileged.
